svg.title: Zepbound vs Wegovy: what the head-to-head evidence shows
svg.desc: Zepbound vs Wegovy: what the head-to-head evidence shows. Head-to-head trial in obesity: SURMOUNT-5: 751 adults, 72 weeks, open-label, Lilly-funded: 20.2% vs 13.7% weight loss. Verdict: Zepbound ahead. Head-to-head trial in type 2 diabetes: SURPASS-2: 1,879 adults, 40 weeks: tirzepatide lowered blood sugar more. Verdict: Tirzepatide ahead. Pooled head-to-head studies: 10 studies, 41,381 people (trials plus records): 4.28 points more weight loss. Verdict: Tirzepatide ahead. Real-world health records: Up to 9.6% vs 6.2% weight loss, but median use was only about 4.6 months. Verdict: Smaller gap. Stopping because of side effects: SURMOUNT-5: 6.1% vs 8.0%; pooled studies: no significant difference. Verdict: No clear difference. Serious side effects: SURMOUNT-5: 4.8% vs 3.5%; pooled studies: more common on tirzepatide. Verdict: Open question. Heart attacks, strokes, deaths: Only Wegovy's label has a heart-risk indication; no head-to-head outcome trial. Verdict: Untested head-to-head. Higher-dose Wegovy HD vs Zepbound: Wegovy HD was approved March 2026; no trial has compared the two. Verdict: Untested.
